geom-logp.label: GEOM-Drugs · logP
geom-logp.description: Target lipophilicity for drug-like molecules. Typical targets lie around 0–5; extreme values extrapolate.

qm9-logp.label: QM9 · logP
qm9-logp.description: Target lipophilicity for small molecules. Most held-out targets lie between −3 and 3.

geom-count.label: GEOM-Drugs · atom count
geom-count.description: Target the total number of atoms, including H. Counts above 71 extrapolate beyond the empirical target range; validity decreases at large N.

geom.label: GEOM-Drugs · unconditional
geom.description: Generate drug-like molecules without a property target. Explicit hydrogens; epoch 100.

qm9.label: QM9 · unconditional
qm9.description: Generate small molecules without a property target. Explicit hydrogens; epoch 1,500.

chembl-explicit.label: ChEMBL3D · explicit H
chembl-explicit.description: Generate ChEMBL3D molecules with explicit hydrogen atoms. Epoch 400.

chembl-implicit.label: ChEMBL3D · heavy atoms
chembl-implicit.description: Generate ChEMBL3D molecules with implicit hydrogens. N counts heavy atoms only. Epoch 300.
